user.title: Bright login
user.description: Use the same email and password as the Bright app.

charges.title: History and tariff
charges.description: Prices including VAT. For a two-tier tariff such as Utilita Smart Energy, set the First Rate and its daily allowance (e.g. 2 kWh); usage after the allowance is charged at the unit rate. Leave the allowance at 0 for a single-rate tariff. Leave every price for a fuel at 0 to skip cost tracking for it.

data.gas_unit_rate: Gas unit rate (Saver Rate on a two-tier tariff)
data.gas_first_rate_kwh: Gas First Rate allowance per day

data_description.history_months: How far back to load from Bright. 0 loads everything since your meter's first reading. History loads in 10-day chunks in the background after setup. Raising this later re-imports all history using your current prices.

reauth_confirm.title: Bright login expired
reauth_confirm.description: Bright rejected the password for {username}. Enter the current one.

error.invalid_auth: Bright rejected that email or password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Glowmarkt API. Try again in a few minutes.
error.no_meters: This Bright account has no electricity or gas meter data yet.

abort.already_configured: This Bright account is already set up.

init.title: History and tariff
init.description: Prices including VAT. For a two-tier tariff such as Utilita Smart Energy, set the First Rate and its daily allowance (e.g. 2 kWh); usage after the allowance is charged at the unit rate. Leave the allowance at 0 for a single-rate tariff. New prices apply from the last 3 days onward; older costs keep the price they were imported with.
